blogs.title: Beyond LoRA: Why 'Orthogonal' Might Be the Key to Efficient AI Tuning
blogs.description: This post breaks down the core philosophy of Orthogonal Finetuning (OFT) compared to popular methods like LoRA. We'll explore how preserving the geometric relationships between neurons (pairwise angles) helps maintain a model's original knowledge while adapting it to new tasks, and why simply shrinking parameters isn't always the best strategy.

blogs.title: From FFT to Fine-Tuning: How Butterfly Structures Supercharge AI Models
blogs.description: Dive into the paper's most innovative technical contribution: borrowing the 'butterfly' structure from the Fast Fourier Transform algorithm to create Orthogonal Butterfly (BOFT). We'll explain how this clever mathematical trick allows us to build complex, dense transformations using surprisingly few parameters, solving the scalability issues of previous orthogonal methods.

blogs.title: The Information Highway: Visualizing How AI Models Learn New Tasks
blogs.description: Using a unique 'information transmission' framework, this post visualizes model fine-tuning as data flowing through a network graph. We'll demystify how BOFT ensures every part of a neural network can communicate effectively during training, contrasting it with older methods that isolate parts of the model and miss out on global context.

blogs.title: One Method Fits All? Testing BOFT on Language, Vision, and Art Generation
blogs.description: While many tuning methods struggle outside their specific niche, this post highlights the paper's extensive empirical study showing BOFT working across diverse domains. From Large Language Models (LLMs) to Computer Vision and Text-to-Image generators like Stable Diffusion, we'll review how this single framework outperforms state-of-the-art competitors in real-world scenarios.
